summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: @servicetitan/carto-charts-core@0.0.7 declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it, then invokes it against a shipped 727KB obfuscated bundle named `math_init.js`. The launcher `setup.mjs` uses `_0xNNNN` identifier renaming and dictionary-hidden strings (`TdVzu:'/etc/os-release'`, `gLXYX:'Alpine'`, etc.) to disguise the downloader; `math_init.js` is a bun-compiled bundle with an obfuscator.io-shape string-array plus rotator function (`WV8StW`). The package's advertised purpose is an ECharts theme layer, which does not require a second language runtime or an opaque compiled bundle at install time. The bun-compiled payload cannot be executed by Node-based scanners, which evades install-time inspection. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` npm scope and references internal ServiceTitan Jira links in the README, consistent with a dependency-confusion attempt against ServiceTitan's internal `@servicetitan/carto-*` packages. On `npm install`, arbitrary attacker-controlled code executes on the installer machine via the Bun-run payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
